notes: 5 Section 17 tests pass in crates/kria-core/tests/memory_graph_v2.rs. Adaptive sampling is implemented via the tracing level hierarchy: security/recovery events (RecoveryMode entry, dead-letter promotion, schema corruption, write-guard, slow-path failures) are all at WARN or ERROR — they survive any INFO-or-higher subscriber filter unconditionally. Routine operational events (rebuild progress, reconcile counts, migration applied) use INFO; debug-level events (cold-start secret skip, catch-up sweep, signal-skipped) use DEBUG and are silenced at INFO-or-higher filter with near-zero overhead (5µs for 1000 checks). The mock counting subscriber tests (17.4, 17.5) confirm the sampling invariants directly. cargo check -p kria-core exits 0. Owner self-review per dev-context.md.
